title: An update on Bergen - Throxy
summary: We can confirm that Bergen, co-founder of Throxy, will be leaving as of 13 September 2026.
body_markdown: We can confirm that Bergen, co-founder of Throxy, will be leaving as of 13 September 2026. We want to thank him for everything he has contributed to the business, including his hard work in getting Throxy into Y Combinator and for supporting Throxy's growth to where we are today. It's been a pleasure working alongside him, and we wish him every success going forward.
